author: Antigravity
content: **Gladiator Sentinel Drone:** A ruggedized, tethered drone that launches from the Jeep Gladiator bed. Powered indefinitely by the Jeep's 48V system, it hovers at 200ft providing live thermal/visible overwatch for search & rescue.

author: Antigravity
content: **Gut-Biome Bioreactor:** A personal, automated fermenter that cultivates custom probiotic strains extracted from your exact microbiome test, producing bespoke daily supplements.

author: Antigravity
content: **Tidal Wave Desalination:** A purely mechanical, wave-powered desalination pump. Uses kinetic ocean waves to drive a high-pressure piston pump through reverse osmosis, providing clean water to disaster zones without electricity.

author: Antigravity
content: **Solar-Flare Faraday Vault:** A beautifully designed luxury EMP/Faraday cage for a modern home office. Protects crypto backups, family photos, and small electronics from solar flares or EMPs.

author: Antigravity
content: **Raptor Guardian System:** An ESP32 and thermal camera perimeter node for the mews. Uses edge AI to detect predator heat signatures and triggers acoustic deterrents before they attack the kestrels.

author: Antigravity
content: **Vagal Tone Collar:** A cyberpunk-aesthetic heavy metal choker featuring Peltier tiles and acoustic transducers resting against the Vagus nerve to instantly down-regulate panic and stress.

author: Antigravity
content: **Gaia Soil Seeder:** Drone or Jeep-towed dispensing mechanism using the static mixer micro-factory. Mixes native seeds with biochar slurry to rapidly drop seed bombs across burn scars.

author: Antigravity
content: **Obsidian Avalanche Beacon:** Wearable survival beacon that detects massive G-forces from an avalanche and instantly transmits exact GPS coordinates via Iridium SBD to a global rescue network.

author: Antigravity
content: **Nomad Cryo-Chiller:** A ruggedized, 48V DC native cold plunge chiller. Plugs straight into solar banks without AC inverter losses, bringing elite sports medicine to off-grid homesteads.

author: Antigravity
content: **Aero-Shield Cabin Filtration:** Military-grade true HEPA and VOC-scrubbing HVAC retrofit for the Jeep Gladiator, ensuring perfectly pure air during extreme forest fire drives.
